name: @openrelic/alchemy
description: Deploy Open Relic with Alchemy and bind Artifacts-compatible namespaces to Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.build: bun run build:js && bun run build:worker && bun run build:types
scripts.build:js: bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/worker.ts --outdir ./dist --target node --format esm --external alchemy --external 'alchemy/*' --external effect --external 'effect/*'
scripts.build:worker: bun build ../../apps/api/src/index.ts --outfile ./dist/open-relic-worker.js --target node --format esm --external cloudflare:workers --loader .sql:text && bun build ./src/namespace-worker.ts --outfile ./dist/namespace-worker.js --target browser --format esm --external cloudflare:workers
